description: Defines the AccessTokenEntity class implementing OAuth2 access token behavior within the OrangeHRM system, including token properties and scope management.

classes.name: AccessTokenEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 access token, managing token data such as identifier, expiration, user, client, and scopes, with methods to set and retrieve these properties.

methods.name: setPrivateKey
methods.description: Method required by interface, not used here as JWT is not employed.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the encrypted string representation of the token's identifier.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the token's expiration date and time.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiration date and time, overriding with a UTC-based time plus token TTL.

methods.name: getUserIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the associated user's identifier, if any.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client application associated with the token.

methods.name: setClient
methods.description: Assigns a client application to the token.

methods.name: addScope
methods.description: Adds a scope to the token's scope list.

methods.name: getScopes
methods.description: Returns all scopes associated with the token.
